h1: Lead handling that sorts, scores and routes new enquiries
overview: When a new lead arrives from your form, store or inbox, this workflow reads it, pulls out the key details and gives it a simple score based on rules you agree with us. High scoring leads go to a salesperson with a short summary, while the rest receive a polite first reply or a nurture email. Everything is built inside your own CRM or tools, and the scoring rules are written in plain words.

faq: Which CRMs and tools can you connect?
Most common ones, including HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Google Sheets, Airtable and Shopify. Tell us what you use in the order form and we confirm it before work starts.
Does the system reply to leads on its own?
Only if you want it to. By default replies are drafted and a person sends them. We can allow automatic replies for simple cases once you have seen the drafts and are happy.
By rules we write with you, such as budget mentioned, country, product asked about or how fast they replied. You can read every rule and change the weights later. It is not a hidden black box.
Can you scrape lead lists for me?
No. We only handle leads that come to you through your own forms, store, ads or inbox. We do not collect or resell contact data, and we follow email and privacy rules.
